capabilities: Size, color and glow nodes by metrics
Detect and name clusters with Louvain and TF-IDF
Filter nodes with graph syntax and metric operators
Export views as PNG, JSON or GEXF
extras: Desktop only (isDesktopOnly: true); makes no network requests; note-open counts are logged locally and can be exported to CSV or erased.
intentEvidence: Alternative graph view for large vaults with 3D visualization, clusters, PageRank and color schemes.
problem: Obsidian's built-in graph view gives little control over how nodes are sized, colored or filtered, and large vaults become hard to read.

relations.evidence: Install the BRAT plugin from Community Plugins and enable it.
graph data as JSON or GEXF (Gephi)

summary: Interactive 2D and 3D graph view for large vaults with PageRank, clustering, metric filters, overlays and local usage tracking.
